tasks.short: Verify surgical necessity and choose the procedure.

steps.what: Retrieve actual medical history, medication allergies and examination results in clinical record software {OTHER}
inputs: actual patient identity
actual existing history, allergy list and examination records
outputs: checked relevant patient records and source dates

steps.what: Analyze history, allergies, physical condition and results to verify necessity and determine best operation
inputs: checked relevant patient records and source dates
actual patient examination and discussion

inputs: actual surgical necessity assessment and chosen procedure with limitations

tasks.design: Configure native patient-specific history, allergy and result views in clinical record software {OTHER}. The surgeon verifies actual sources, retains all clinical assessment and procedure choice, then records and commits the checked final assessment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Surgical assessment can repeat navigation among existing patient records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient/source filters can reduce retrieval navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Surgical necessity and procedure suitability require clinical judgement and patient examination.
tasks.human_edge: The surgeon recognises when recorded findings do not justify an operation.
tasks.altitude: Less record navigation; operative judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical record views can bring existing patient history, allergies and results together; they do not verify surgical necessity.

assumptions: Actual clinical record owners supply patient-linked history, allergy status, examination dates and results. Surgeon checks identity/currentness in s1; missing or contradictory data remains manual in s2.

Only repeated navigation loses time. Examination, source interpretation, patient discussion, procedure choice and assessment capture remain fully retained. No automatic consent, order or operation is assumed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native views first; existing consolidated access earns zero saving. Routine commit retains one percent and uses existing final record check. Shared assessment/record work across 22747 and 22748 is counted once.
unknowns: How much relevant-record retrieval remains fragmented?
research_questions: Can native views shorten retrieval while preserving full clinical review?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 record navigation = 10; minus 0.5 upkeep = 9.5. Half eligible gives 5 minus 0.5 = 4.5. Clinical assessment, record capture and commit retained.

tasks.design: Configure native source/topic links in the research library and research record software {OTHER}, with originals in {DOCS}. The surgeon retains hypothesis, design, actual testing, observation and interpretation, then records the checked findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research preparation can repeat source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source/topic links can reduce discovery effort.
tasks.still_hard: Novel technique safety and outcome interpretation require actual research.
tasks.human_edge: The surgeon recognises a clinically important limitation absent from a plausible summary.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research-library links and topic filters can support surgical evidence discovery; they do not develop, validate or authorise a new surgical technique.

assumptions: Actual researchers supply original studies and actual collected outcome records, checked in s1. No automatic outcome extraction or free primary capture is assumed; observation and capture remain in s3/s4.

Design, hands-on testing and interpretation remain fully retained. Actual testing requires actual existing research permissions before intervention; no new authority or avoided approval time is claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing source access earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent and uses the existing full final check. Publication or external submission is a separate actual gated duty.
research_questions: Can native filters reduce navigation without reducing original-study reading?

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final surgical research record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 source navigation = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Design, testing, actual capture and save retained.

tasks.design: Configure native patient-context views and encounter templates in clinical record software {OTHER}. The surgeon diagnoses and treats the actual patient, captures actual outcomes and fully checks the final encounter record before committing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Encounters can repeat context navigation and stable record identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient views and encounter templates can reduce navigation and duplicate fields.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnosis, treatment, safety and actual response assessment require the surgeon.
tasks.human_edge: The surgeon adapts clinical care to the actual patient's condition.
tasks.altitude: Less encounter administration; diagnosis and treatment stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native patient views and encounter templates can reduce repeated navigation/identifiers; they do not perform orthopedic diagnosis or treatment.

assumptions: Actual record owners supply existing patient/history fields, checked in s1. Surgeon performs actual examination, diagnoses and chooses care in s2; clinical treatment and safety checks remain fully retained in s3.

S4 reduces repeated identifiers and stable headings only; actual diagnosis, procedure, observed response and complete final verification stay in retained 11.2 hours. Outcomes are recorded only after actual treatment.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines; clinic, ward and operating-room care are alternative contexts requiring actual reweighting. Native templates first; existing automated fields earn zero saving.

S3 gate is the actual clinical treatment decision and patient-specific safety/consent conditions, with no extra approval time. Medication prescriptions or operative orders, if actual duties, must each be separate exact-final-order gated commits; this graph claims no avoided order time.
Routine record commit retains one percent and consumes the existing final check. Shared care/record work under 22745 or 22748 is counted once.
unknowns: Which encounter fields are manually duplicated?
research_questions: Can native templates reduce duplication after complete clinical record checking?
